analysis: The only change in this PR is to docs/architecture/inference.md: the 'Last updated' date bumped to 2026-10-23 (line 3), plus a new paragraph at head lines 874-878. The supplied units are head-text excerpts from lines 1214-2038 of the same file, which fall outside the changed ranges. They are surrounding documentation, so I examined them as context only. The new paragraph itself (head 874-878) is not in the supplied units, so I only saw it in the patch excerpt. It describes rendering OpenRouter-returned reasoning on earlier assistant turns as the template's reasoning_content, and serving `strict` tools by validating each auto call against its schema before exposure rather than by constraining decoding. This is documentation only, with no code, config or control change, so it does not change any trust boundary or mitigation. The surrounding text covers the prefix cache (T-041), the deadline and MTP policy, and the vision/media caps; none of it is modified, and nothing there touches A-001, A-003, TB-007 or the prefix-cache mitigations. One question remains for a code-bearing pass: the paragraph implies provider code that replays consumer or OpenRouter-supplied reasoning text into the prompt (GLM5NextPromptPolicy.RawControls, returnedReasoning). Whether that implementation preserves prompt-injection boundaries, and whether the strict-tool validation (ToolConstraintValidation.validate) fails closed, is not verifiable from these units. Those source changes, if they exist in this PR, should be reviewed with their own files. No finding is warranted from the docs alone.
